title: The Foundry
text: On Cinder, the molten inner planet. Meridian's factory in the system: it printed all three probes for every run, side by side in three cradles in one hall (the first is worn to Accord's shape), and launched them on the same instant from one rail that climbs due north, aimed at Orrin, the navigation buoy. The voyages from Earth never happened: each probe's 214-year voyage log was uploaded at the foot of the rail a fraction of a second before launch. The Director's booth is here: a chair, a light, a lens and three files, ACCORD / KINDRED / ENGRAM BRIEF, TAKE 1. Its guards are the pattern Accord's units are copied from (Rovers, Tanks, Lancers in white), which don't answer the handshake. Its log already reads "Stock on hand for run 13". Comet K-7, whose tail is refined isotope stock, passes within a day of it every perihelion: its larder.
